checks.detail: Primary source is pinned to the exact SIA example-building documentation SHA-256.
Soltis 92-2048-Alu by SergeFerrari is named in both source documents.
One-centimetre gaps on top, sides and bottom and 0.5 mm screen thickness are recorded.
For both states, g_total equals direct solar transmittance plus secondary internal heat transfer: 0.545=0.479+0.066 and 0.059=0.040+0.019.
Secondary transfer equals convection plus thermal radiation plus ventilation for both states.
The 150 W/m2 value is retained while unresolved signal, operator and release semantics remain explicitly unqualified.
